products.title: Highland Slim Cut
products.description: High-rise slim fit jean in Japanese 3×1 broken twill denim with a ‘lived' light indigo wash. 100% cotton with five-pocket design featuring a reversed fifth pocket with signature contrast stitching at the front and a functional guitar pick pocket at the back right. products.title: Leather Trucker Jacket
products.description: Trucker jacket crafted from cowhide leather with hair-on paneled sections at the front and back, as seen in Look 10 of the At First Light debut Paris Runway Show. Cut in a classic fit with traditional detailing, including a point collar and two flap chest pockets. Features adjustable back cinches and a western-style rear yoke. Fully lined for comfort. Finished with two welt pockets at the front waist and button closures throughout. Made in Turkey.

products.title: Satin Teddy Jacket
products.description:
Classic raglan sleeve satin teddy jacket, crafted in Japanese rayon sateen. Snap fastening closure at the front with two front-entry welt pockets. Rib knit trim at the neck, cuffs, and hem with contrast stripes. Contrast piping runs down the sleeves. Felt embroidered graphics feature the ‘AP' logo at the front chest and ‘Long Rides Longer Nights' mantra at the back.
58% Cotton / 42% Rayon.
